mapper.sql: select a.article_id, a.article_type, a.title, a.cover_image, a.summary, cast(a.content as char) as content, a.related_plant_id, p.plant_name as related_plant_name, a.status, a.sort_order, a.publish_time, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from zx_content_article a left join zx_plant p on a.related_plant_id = p.plant_id
mapper.insert: insert into zx_content_article (article_type, title, cover_image, summary, content, related_plant_id, status, sort_order, publish_time, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{articleType}, #{title}, #{coverImage}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{relatedPlantId}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{publishTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update zx_content_article set article_type = #{articleType}, title = #{title}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, related_plant_id = #{relatedPlantId}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where article_id = #{articleId}
